Try not to get caught on the wrong end of its barbs.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 22 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Enhanced Lizal Spear}} Lizal Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by [[Lizalfos]] for both fishing and combat. They can commonly be found on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and in the [[Gerudo Desert]], where they are often wielded by [[Blue Lizalfos]]. They can also be found in the hands of [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]]. These Spears are part of the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created by Lizalfos.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Because of their metallic spearheads, Enhanced Lizal Spears will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up again using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
